insights.title: Key Insights

insights.effectiveMedium: With an effective tax rate of {rate}, you're in a reasonable tax bracket while contributing fairly to public services.
insights.effectiveHigh: Your effective tax rate is {rate}. Strategic tax planning through maximized reliefs can help optimize your tax position.
insights.reliefsSaved: By claiming {amount} in tax reliefs, you saved {savings} in taxes this year.

insights.lifestylePotential: Don't miss out on lifestyle relief (up to RM2,500). Gym memberships, sports equipment, and books qualify.
insights.medicalPotential: You can claim up to {amount} for parents' medical expenses if they don't exceed RM{threshold} annual income.
insights.zakatBenefit: Your zakat payment of {amount} provides a direct rebate, reducing your tax from {before} to {after}.

insights.affordability: Based on your monthly payment of {payment}, your DSR is {dsr}. Banks typically approve loans with DSR below 70%.
insights.interestSavings: By paying an extra {amount} monthly, you could save {savings} in interest and finish {months} months earlier.
insights.epfProjection: At your current contribution rate, your EPF balance will grow to {amount} by retirement at age {age}.
insights.shortfall: Warning: Your projected retirement fund of {amount} may fall short of your target of {target}.

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.maximizeReliefsDesc: Ensure you're claiming all eligible tax reliefs including EPF, insurance, education, and lifestyle expenses.
recommendations.increaseEPFDesc: Additional EPF contributions not only build retirement savings but also provide tax relief up to RM4,000.
recommendations.considerPRSDesc: Private Retirement Scheme contributions qualify for additional tax relief up to RM3,000.
recommendations.payZakatDesc: Zakat payments provide a direct rebate on your tax bill, reducing your final tax payable.
recommendations.refinanceDesc: Current market rates may be lower than your loan rate. Refinancing could reduce your monthly payment and total interest.
recommendations.extraPaymentsDesc: Even small additional payments can significantly reduce your total interest and loan tenure.
recommendations.diversifyDesc: Don't rely solely on EPF. Consider other investment vehicles for better returns.
recommendations.reviewBudgetDesc: Your expenses are high relative to income. Review your budget to increase savings capacity.
recommendations.buildEmergencyDesc: Aim for 6 months of expenses as an emergency fund before aggressive investing.
recommendations.seekAdviceDesc: For complex tax situations or significant wealth, consult a certified tax advisor or financial planner.
